segments.text: Welcome back to GitHub awesome. This is GitHub trending weekly number 33. 35 trending open- source projects on GitHub right now. Let's get into it.
Mirage is a unified virtual file system for AI agents. Mounts S3, Google Drive, GitHub, Reddus, Postgress sidebyside
into a single Unix file system. LLMs are already fluent in bash. So your agent uses cat, GP, and WC to pipe data from a Google doc into a Slack channel.
natively parses parquet, JSON, even wave files. Snapshot, clone, and roll back the entire workspace just like git.
Deeps from Versel Labs is an AI security harness orchestrating coding agents like clawed opus 4.7 or GPT 5.5 to investigate your entire codebase.
Multi-stage workflow flags sensitive files, traces data flows, checks mitigations, then a revalidate pass
aggressively cuts false positives. Fan out across a thousand plus concurrent versell sandboxes or run locally on your clawed code subscription.
Coded long enough to remember the golden era of DOSs. Trust is coding Rust like it's 1989. A gorgeous fully functional
retro terminal UI IDE for modern Rust projects. Completely replicates the iconic blue screen environment of Turbo Pascal and Borland C++. Full mouse
support to click and drag text. Split pane project browser. Dedicated bottom panel captures cargo build and cargo test output.
Hermes desktop is a native Mac OS app connecting to your Hermes host via pure direct SSH. No gateways, no dams, no
local mirrors. Beautiful guey for managing sessions, editing skills and remote files with conflict checks, managing cron jobs, viewing the agents
canban board. Multi-agent profiles keep your coding, research and ops agents isolated on the same server. Token speed
from Lightseek was built from scratch for agentic workloads and is beating Tensor RT LLM in direct benchmarks. A
pluggable kernel layer and C++ finite state machineuler that guarantees KV cache safety at compile time. Native
optimization for speculative decoding and multi head latent attention on NVIDIA B200 Blackwell. 9% lower latency,
11% higher throughput. Decode latency cut almost in half.
AvNAC is Canvas spelled backwards. A lightning fast browser first design editor for posters, layouts, and social graphics. Local first architecture.
Everything happens on your machine.
Autosave to index DB. Multi select group alignment. Nested vector drawing areas, image cropping, custom shadows, native
QR code generation. Built-in magic panel brings prompt driven AI editing straight into your local canvas.
Salvator Sanfalippo, the creator of Reddus, just dropped a masterclass for the local AI community. DS4 is a native
ultra optimized local inference engine for Deepseek V4 flash on Apple silicon using Metal. Treats your SSD as a first
class citizen for the KV cache, streaming live conversation context to disk instead of hogging unified memory.
Switch chat sessions or restart the server and it instantly resumes exact context without reprocessing thousands of prompt tokens.
Gemma chat is a gorgeous open- source electron app running Google's new Gemma 4 fully locally on Apple Silicon via
MLX. No API keys, no cloud. Code never leaves your machine. Build mode writes HTML, CSS,JS in front of you with a live
preview canvas updating in real time as the model types. Multifile projects, built-in whisper voice input, instant swapping between Gemma 4 parameter
sizes, an incredibly capable terminal native autonomous AI agent. Doth a thing is built by Ricardo Spangi, former lead
maintainer of Monero. Tagline, you describe the thing, it does the thing. A full stack operator, searches the web
via Seir XNG, bypasses bot detection with Camu Fox, runs shell commands, sends and receives emails through agent
mail, farms easy work to cheap models, autonomously upgrades to GPT 5.5 when stuck.
RKN block checker is a Python CLI that inspects connections layer by layer, walks through DNS, TCP, TLS, and HTTP
independently, and stops at the exact point of failure. tells you deterministically whether it's DNS poisoning, an ISP level TCP reset, or
advanced DPI hardware dropping the connection based on TLS SNI headers.
Knowing where the stack broke tells you exactly how to fix it. Agent Rules Books distills 13 legendary software
engineering books into strict, actionable markdown rules optimized for AI agents. Clean code, domain driven
design, refactoring, designing data inensive applications. Drop them into your project and your agent applies rigorous battle tested architecture
instead of junior dev habits. Every rule set ships in three sizes, full, mini, and nano for tight token budgets.
PS5 Linux loader from Andying aka the flow literally turns your console into a fully unlocked Linux PC and Steam
machine. Leverages a patched hypervisor vulnerability to boot a custom payload with raw hardware access. All eight Zen
2 cores at 3.5 GHz. RDNA2 GPU at 2.23 GHz, 4K at 60 fps, runs Steam games like
GTA 5 with ray tracing, doesn't break your SSD. Reboot puts you back into Sony game OS.
Open Swarm is clawed code for everything except coding. An open- source multi-agent system running from your terminal. One prompt, an orchestrator
delegates to eight specialized AI experts. Need an investor deck? Deep Research pulls competitor data. Data
analyst builds charts in an isolated Python kernel. Image generation creates assets. Slides exports a formatted PowerPoint.
The most important step in AI coding is writing bulletproof specs before the AI writes a single line.
Writer computer is a gorgeous local first desktop markdown editor for AI engineering workflows. Draft, review, and iterate on detailed project specs.
Then spin up AI agents to execute those docs in parallel while you sleep. Native rendering for mermaid diagrams and charts makes mapping complex architectures effortless.
Mac downloads or desktop and absolute disaster zone. Binky quietly runs in your menu bar. Zero setup tax. Free open
source pointed at a messy inbox like downloads. Once a file finishes downloading, it autoes into tidy buckets. Images, PDFs, archives,
documents. Unknown files land in a review folder first so nothing silently disappears. watches multiple folders, respects Finder tags, 100% local.
Beautiful HTML templates is a curated library of 32 gorgeous productionready HTML slide templates designed
specifically for a coding agents ships with an agents.md operating manual. Tell your AI build me a pitch deck and the
agent reads the manual, searches metadata for the perfect template matching the mood, builds a threelide preview, and generates the final deck.
A completely free drop-in design system for the new Unity 6 UI toolkit. Unity-UI document design system leverages UI
document UXML and USS to bring weblike UI development straight into your game.
Design tokens, pre-built responsive components, full icon set, runtime helper, gorgeous dark theme by default, every component fully keyboard and touch
ready. GH dashboard is a polished self-hosted local web app that acts as your GitHub command center. pulls data
from GitHub's REST and GraphQL APIs into one unified interface. Repo Grid with health scores, cross repo issue and PR
tracking, actions, workflows, live traffic analytics. GitHub OOTH via device authorization flow keeps tokens
strictly server side. Optional OpenAI integration generates daily digest summaries.
Tell Codeex, improve this project and you get unbounded edits, premature completion claims, and stale verification. Goal Buddy splits one
vague goal into a structured loop. Scout maps the repo. Judge picks the safe task. Worker executes a single bounded
slice with explicit allowed files and stop conditions. Receipts written.
Verification runs before anything is marked complete. Avonic is an open agentic AI platform.
Instead of running fragile loose scripts, Avonic gives your AI workforce a structured highly secure environment.
automatically spins up fully isolated Docker containers whenever your agent runs Python or Bash. Strict memory
limits, isolated file system, restricted network access, a hallucinating agent can never wipe your drive.
Photo Agents reimagines AI memory like biology. A vision grounded framework where autonomous self-evolving agents
literally see and operate your computer the same way you do. layered memory system, working global SOP and session
archives. As the agent perceives your screen and completes tasks, it autonomously writes and saves its own reusable skills.
Spending all day staring at boring terminal logs while your AI grinds through code. Claude Pets brings joy to
your workflow. A cute animated desktop companion that acts as a live status indicator for Cloud Code. Connect via
MCP server and a little pet lives on your desktop, reacts to what your AI is doing, paces while Claude thinks, reacts
when the agent finishes a task or hits an error.
MTPLX is a native multi-token prediction runtime for Apple Silicon and MLX.
Leverages the target model's own built-in MTP heads to draft multiple tokens at once. Uses exact probability ratio acceptance, the Leviathan Chenma, to verify over 2.24x 24x faster decode.
28 tokens per second jumps to 63 on a 27 billion parameter Quen with zero accuracy loss.
MIRI is a near-ish keyboard first window manager for Mac OS. Neri uses a scrollable tiling layout where windows exist on an infinite horizontal strip
instead of a static grid. Meri brings that workflow natively to your Mac.
Builtin Swift leverages Mac OS accessibility APIs to seamlessly tile applications, navigate workspaces, and snap columns entirely with your keyboard.
An open-source alternative to OpenClaw built to deploy directly into your own Cloudflare account. Downey lets you build a dedicated team of hyperfocused
AI workers instead of one monolithic super agent, product manager, growth marketing, SEO. Each agent gets its own
persistent memory, personality, workspace, and tool set, all powered by Cloudflare durable objects.
Solidity caught auditor is a strict chain of thought auditing skill for your coding agent. Instead of blindly generating contracts or giving lazy
reviews, it forces your AI to slow down and perform rigorous step-by-step security analysis.
explicitly maps state changes, analyzes control flow, and actively hunts for re-entry, flash loan manipulation, and
access control flaws before outputting code.
A brand new completely cross-platform file system notification library for Go FS Notify normalizes behavior across Mac
OS, Windows, and Linux. Write your file watching logic once, a native ad recursive method. Pointed at the root, it watches the entire subree, including
any new folders created inside. Handles horrible edge cases, ddup sim links, full thread safety across gorout teams.
Metal FX is a stunning animated liquid metal border component powered by real-time WebGL shaders. Wrap your buttons or cards in the Metal FX React
component, and a meme flowing liquid metal edge applies instantly. Presets like chromatic, silver, gold. Tweak
animation speed, distortion, glow tint, or apply effects like molten steel, brushed metal, morphing blobs.
A brilliant MCP server that acts as a cost-aware router for your terminal coding agents. Codeca operates on one
genius principle. Your expensive frontier model is the tech lead. A cheaper model like DeepSeek is the junior developer, intercepts your workflow, and splits the cognition.
autonomously delegates low-risk grunt work to DeepSeek, which generates a patch. Your premium model reviews, checks security, and applies it.
Harness brings AIdriven user testing to your desktop. A free native Mac OS tool for iOS simulator, Mac OS apps, and web
apps. Type a goal in plain English like sign up for a new account and pick a persona. An LLM agent takes over, reads
the screen visually, clicks forms using set of mark targeting, types credentials, hits a confusing menu, flags it as a friction event, generates a replayable timeline.
Atlas is a blazing fast pure Rust and CUDA inference engine built from scratch for NVIDIA's new Blackwell architecture like the DGX Spark. Zero Python in the serving path. Container drops to 2.5 GB.
Cold starts under 2 minutes. Custom CUDA kernels and native MTP speculative decoding hit over 100 tokens per second
on a 35 billion parameter Quen 3.6, nearly 3x faster than VLM.
Cursed browser has no rendering engine.
None. Takes the raw HTML of any website, sends it directly to a vision language model, and tells the AI to hallucinate
what it thinks the web page should look like. Doesn't render a functional DOM, just generates an image prediction.
Every page load gives you completely unpredictable layout, fonts, and images.
Codeex Island turns the physical notch on your MacBook into a glowing dynamic island style live activity meter for
clawed code and open AI codecs. Lives in the notch instead of cluttering your menu bar. Click it to see exactly how many tokens you've burned and how close
you are to your rate limit. Trackpad swipe to see dollar spend. Zero servers, zero accounts, zero telemetry. reads credentials from your Mac OS keychain.
Chorus is a multimodel code review panel. Takes AI CLIs you already have installed, Claude Code, Codeex, Gemini,
Open Code, and runs them in parallel on the same git diff. Forces them to review, argue, vote, and only ship code at consensus. Wraps your existing subscriptions, so zero extra API bills.
Runs entirely local with embedded PGE. No Docker needed.
an agentnative video creation pipeline built on the Hermes framework. Feed it a single creative seed and the agent
autonomously expands it into branching storylines. Pick a path and it orchestrates the entire production, writes the script, prompts external
models for storyboard rendering, synthesizes voiceover dubbing, edits it all into a final publish ready video.
That wraps up all 35 projects featured in GitHub Trending Weekly number 33. All links are in the description.
